user.title: Add Kramer Protocol 3000 device
user.description: Enter the device address. Leave input/output counts at 0 to discover via INFO-IO?. TCP usually uses port 5000; UDP usually uses port 50000. Manually change the port when choosing UDP.

data_description.command_family: Auto first tries ROUTE?, then VID?. Extended X-ROUTE is not supported in this version.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or receive a Protocol 3000 model response
error.not_protocol_3000: The device did not identify itself using Protocol 3000

abort.already_configured: This address and protocol are already configured

init.title: Kramer AV routing options
init.description: Comma-separated friendly names in physical port order. Leave an item blank to retain its numeric label. Names are suffixes, e.g. 'Input 1 — PC'.
